question: How can I customize the class name that users will instantiate when using my Swift SDK?
ground_truth: You can customize the class name that users will instantiate when using your Swift SDK by setting the `clientClassName` configuration option in your `generators.yml` file. For example, setting `clientClassName: YourClientName` will generate a client class with that name.

metadata.cited_context: The name of the generated client class. This allows you to customize the class name that users will instantiate when using your SDK.
